descriptions.no-task-trading: The Trading Task is not shown to this user, because: (1) the Trading Task has been turned off; (2) the Trading Task has been blocked for this user (reason set in config, e.g. blacklist, A-Book); or (3) the Trading Task has been hidden from all users. The Daily Trading card and the Earn tab are hidden.
descriptions.first-visit: Treats this as the first time Home is opened on the device: the guided tour opens by itself. Without it, the tour opens only once per device, or from the help button in the header.

descriptions.needs-kyc: User has not passed KYC yet. The Daily Trading card shows “How to start” (step 1 is the one to do) instead of today’s figures; the button reads “Verify my account”.
descriptions.needs-deposit: User passed KYC but has not made a first deposit. The Daily Trading card shows “How to start” (step 1 checked, step 2 is the one to do) instead of today’s figures; the button reads “Deposit now”.

descriptions.empty: Balance is 0: no available, pending or expiring coins.
descriptions.has-pending: 120 coins are waiting to be credited: “+120 pending” shows under the balance. May be used when applying the T+1 rule to release coins.
descriptions.expiring: 1,200 coins expire within 10 days: red warning under the balance.

descriptions.capped: Today's max coins reached: the Today panel gets a footer with the capped message.
descriptions.no-trades-today: No trades yet today: 0 lots and 0 coins.
descriptions.market-closed: Weekend (markets closed): the live “Trader … just earned … coins” line is hidden. It runs Sunday 17:00 to Friday 17:00 UTC (Monday to Friday, GMT+7).

descriptions.check-in: Shows the daily check-in card (future feature, not launched).
